name: Flora Malphite
summary: AP line where Malphite holds the board together while Soraka and Zyra carry.
playWhen: You have lots of AP items

opener.note: AP items. Prioritize Rods on the carousel.

stages.stage1: Slam only items the carry or its trait unit will hold later. Otherwise keep components flexible.
stages.stage2: Stay on the cheapest board that fits the trait. Decide between this line and the alternative by 3-2, once you know your items.
stages.stage3: Level for the carry and tanks, and pivot to a connected comp if your items stop fitting.

augmentModifiers.note: Consuming Flora is the core augment for Flora Fatalis.
